gap_propositions.proposition: 有效的客户尽职调查是企业银行反金融犯罪计划的关键组成部分，尤其在企业银行业务中，因为交易金额高、结构复杂且常涉及第三方服务。
source_quotes: Effective CDD is a critical component of any AFC program, but is particularly important in corporate banking.

This is because the transactions are often of higher value, more complex, and might require the services of third parties such as lawyers and accountants if a deal involves multiple financial instructions.

trigger_or_context: 企业银行交易金额高、结构复杂、常涉及第三方
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 有效的客户尽职调查是AFC计划的关键组成部分，在企业银行业务中尤为重要

evidence_spans.quote: Effective CDD is a critical component of any AFC program, but is particularly important in corporate banking.

This is because the transactions are often of higher value, more complex, and might require the services of third parties such as lawyers and accountants if a deal involves multiple financial instructions.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选s1c_003仅承接了企业银行交易特征引发强大交易监控系统的需求，未承接同一交易特征导致客户尽职调查尤为关键这一独立判断链，且遗漏了CDD作为AFC关键组件的处理单元。

gap_propositions.proposition: 为自身及团队投资持续的金融犯罪防控培训被认为是最佳实践，且在大多数司法管辖区是行业标准；参加行业研讨会、工作坊和培训课程可帮助保持企业银行合规最佳实践的最新状态。
source_quotes: It is also considered best practice and in most jurisdictions an industry standard to invest in continuous AFC training for herself and her team. Attending industry seminars, workshops, and training sessions can help Elena stay up to date on the best practices in corporate banking compliance.

basis_or_condition: 持续培训被视为最佳实践和行业标准
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 投资于持续的金融犯罪防控培训
outcomes_or_paths: 帮助团队掌握企业银行合规最新实践

evidence_spans.quote: It is also considered best practice and in most jurisdictions an industry standard to invest in continuous AFC training for herself and her team. Attending industry seminars, workshops, and training sessions can help Elena stay up to date on the best practices in corporate banking compliance.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选覆盖了风险评估、系统控制评估、交易监控和案例和解，但均未涉及持续培训作为最佳实践和行业标准的独立处置单元；此判断链以培训投资为中心，具备明确的依据和结果，属于遗漏。
